Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Trigger Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.Trigger(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Trigger commands are used to set the trigger system of the oscilloscope.

level (float) – Level value

data (int) – 0 to 2^40-1 (max 40 bits)

set_direction(direction)[source]¶

Parameters:

direction (str) – “READ”, “WRITE”, or “RWRITE”

set_dlevel(level)[source]¶

level (float) – Level value

set_scl(source)[source]¶

Parameters:

source (str) – “CHANNEL1” or “CHANNEL2”

set_sda(source)[source]¶

Set the channel source of SDA in I2C trigger.

Parameters:

source (str) – “CHANNEL1” or “CHANNEL2”

set_when(trig_type)[source]¶

Set the trigger condition in I2C trigger.

Parameters:

trig_type (str) – “START”, “RESTART”, “STOP”, “NACKNOWLEDGE”, “ADDRESS”, “DATA”, “ADATA”
